title: Gaussian approximation for a Rademacher tail
statement: For every real threshold $u$ and positive integer $n$, the absolute difference between the probability that the normalized Rademacher sum on the $n$-dimensional sign cube exceeds $u$ and the standard Gaussian upper-tail probability at $u$ is at most $2C n^{-1/2}$, where $C$ is the third-moment Berry–Esseen constant.
